title: Important Update on New Deposit Requirements for Binance P2P Merchant Levels
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We are announcing important changes to the deposit requirements for our Binance P2P Merchant Levels. To upgrade to a higher merchant level, users are required to top up their deposit according to the following new requirements. New Deposit Requirements: Silver Level:  130% of the basic deposit Gold Level:  200% of the basic deposit For example, if the user’s basic deposit is 1,000 USDT, they are required to make the following deposits according to their Binance P2P Merchant Level: Silver Level:  130% of 1000 USDT = 1,300 USDT Gold Level:  200% of 1000 USDT = 2,000 USDT Please note: This change will be gradually rolled out in batches. Please ensure your account meets the new criteria for your desired P2P merchant level to enjoy all the benefits associated with higher merchant levels. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. If you have any questions or need assistance with the deposit process, please reach out to our support team.  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-29
